description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.)"When the Israelites walked around the walls of Jericho did they also walk around on the Sabbath? 
Was Israel ever forbidden to fight/ defend itself on a Sabbath?
Question 1 is what this deception is trying to use as support for a Lunar Sabbath or whatever it is they are believing."
.
.
2.) "Pastor in one of your messages, you said Pharisees and Sadducees created more than 1000 laws and enforce them on Israelites purposely for Israelites to be able to keep the Sabbath. You said when Jesus came he abolished all those laws. What are those 1000-plus laws and where can we find them in the bible.
In another of your messages, you talked about ceremonial laws. What are they, and where did you get them in the bible? "
.
.
